messages:
carla: Heads-up: hitting a weird tokenization mismatch in runtime v3.2 unpin canary for quantized-llama-group in us-east-1. Saw ~0.6% token drift on perf tests vs pinned v3.1.5. Can we pause full unpin and discuss exit criteria?
ben: ack. do we have failing customer traffic or just synthetic traces?
dinesh: only repros in our long-sequence evals and one internal app using edge token offsets. No external incidents yet.
eva: FWIW the model infra trace shows an extra <unk> emitted in ~1k requests, appears correlated with kv-cache warmup + quant route.
carla: exact. quantized runtimes + longKvCache warm paths. short sequences look fine. suggestion: keep runtime pinned for quantized model variants, allow unpin for fp16/gpu64 variants.
ben: that seems safe. what's the surface area to maintain two pin states? deploybot: note - deploybot can apply per-model-group pin masks. would need the pinlist entry: {model_group: "llama-quant", runtime: "v3.1.5"} and a separate allowlist for fp16.
dinesh: sounds good. can we craft canary exit criteria to unblock fp16 unpin but keep quant pinned? propose: (1) no token drift >0.1% on longseq evals over 24h (2) smoke test pass for top-10 production prompts (3) 0 new token-offset regressions in tracelog.
eva: add: run 48h regression-run on canary cluster with kv-cache pre-warm. also require model-level perf SLOs: p95 latency within 5% of v3.1.5.
carla: agree. Ben can you own the rollout steps and release note blurb? we need to mention partial pin and rationale.
ben: taking. I'll prepare a pinned-change window for tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: unpin fp16 subset in canary, monitor 2h, then staged unpin to 10% prod traffic for fp16 if metrics are green. Keep quant pinned until follow-up.
rollout-bot: change-request created: CR-5921 by ben. Window: 2026-07-14T02:00:00Z-2026-07-14T04:00:00Z. Includes canary and staged steps.
carla: add checklist: update release-notes: explain user-visible impact (tokenization drift risk for some prompts), mitigation (quant models still pinned), rollback trigger (token drift >0.2% OR p95 latency >10% inc).
dinesh: also file an eval ticket to reproduce drift with reduced cfg so we can root cause: EVAL-1107.
ben: noted. I'll include EVAL-1107 in CR-5921.
eva: any objections to letting deploybot apply the pinlist mask now as a protective step while we finalize wording?
carla: +1. safer to pre-apply while we finalize canary plan.
deploybot: applied pinlist mask to us-east-1 for model_group=llama-quant runtime=v3.1.5. action: pinned. (audit id: PIN-7782) :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: alert: monitoring policy "tokenization-drift" now enabled for canary clusters. thresholds: 0.1% warning, 0.2% critical.
ben: ok next actions: (1) I will draft release note & CR now, (2) eva will run extended canary eval for 48h, (3) dinesh will prep rollback playbook and smoke scripts, (4) carla will sign off before staged 10% traffic shift.
carla: timeline works. thanks team. we'll reconvene in #eng-releases thread after 48h eval or sooner if alerts fire. :thumbsup:
